provisional_notes: Release notes list features only and are drafted from the ticket titles; check them against the Scrum Presentation 5.3 page, which could not be read.

release_notes.text: APS Standalone viewer with configurable properties (config, camera, cutting planes, navigation, rendering callbacks) and examples; APS with Model Composition and Geo BIM side by side; Graphics Service APIs use the host token; APS tokens created from the Reference App; design for an optional GIS overlay.
Geo BIM View3D: a Mapbox map with each building opening in its own side-by-side View3D pane.
2D drawing-sheet callback and property for host apps; improved Navigator select, deselect, zoom and highlight; 2D/3D toggle without reloading.

IafViewer interface and examples in 17 languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, Malayalam, Bengali, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese (Brazil).
Release validated against 5.2 and 5.1 on qa2 with developer sign-off.
